steps.text:
1. Atm withdrawal limit  
a. Customer can disable atm withdrawal limit as its 
enabled by default  
b. Customer can enter the desired limit not to exceed 
max limit set by the bank.  
2. Card payment limit  
a. Customer can disable card payment limit as its 
enabled by default  
b. Customer can enter the desired limit not to exceed 
max limit set by the bank.  
3. Online purchase limit  
a. Customer can disable card online purchase limit as 
its enabled by default  
b. Customer can enter the desired limit not to exceed 
max limit set by the bank.  
4. Contactless limit  
a. Customer can edit contactless limit  
b. Customer can enter any amount below 300
